Title: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 58 is now generally available - September 2021

Body.Content:
This update provides fixes for issues in the following Azure Site Recovery components.  

  • Mobility Service  (Azure to Azure, and VMware Physical to Azure)
  • Hyper-v to Azure disaster recovery
  • VMware preview architecture 

Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
